notes: Seed URL loads; Election Information page lists results PDFs (Microsoft Reporting Services, text). No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Last-Modified differs per file. In 2026 the county posted one unofficial cumulative and one unofficial precinct report on election night for each election; in 2024 it posted only an unofficial cumulative report (and later official cumulative), no precinct report. Report header 'Precincts Reporting 0 of 7' although votes are present. Rule 47 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-47): none.
tag_rationale: 2026 primary and runoff are END by check 2 (2024 general LATER), so the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT; both have printed run times and upload times on election night, so confidence is med. Rule 47 checked 2026-10-02: no change.
